structure: Each technical subcategory has paradigm splits
logic: Follows clear logical flow (Why-How-Resources-Future or alternative)
content: Avoids generic descriptions like 'discusses various methods'
mekg_alignment: Main sections align with MEKG categories (if available)
Subsections align with MEKG subcategories (if available)
